The `get` method from the `List` interface, as per the provided API documentation, throws an `IndexOutOfBoundsException` if the index is out of the valid range, which in this case would mean if `index < 0` or `index >= size()`.

Since the index is calculated as one less than the size of the list, it will always be a valid index, and thus, the `IndexOutOfBoundsException` is avoided.
